seconds_target: 作業 約4分（スライダー240秒）／休憩 約5分半（330秒）
budget: Suno 360クレジット以内・購入なし（IRO24と同じ上限。残高は着手時に確かめる）
trial: まず各種1回（8回・16曲・80見込み）で声・楽器・尺を確かめ、抜粋を本人が試聴してから残り28回（作業24・休憩4）
adopt: 作業42曲（7曲×6回・7曲目は25:00でフェード）＋休憩6曲（5:00でフェード・−2dB）

leads.name: マリンバ（柔らかいマレット・中低域）
leads.style: Warm wooden marimba in the foreground played with soft yarn mallets in its mellow middle and low register, a simple gentle melody with a few rolled long notes, round and woody, no fast runs, no tropical or island feel. F major, 80 BPM. Instrumental study lo-fi hip hop for a quiet winter afternoon turning into a snowy night, studying at a small desk while snow slowly settles outside the window. A relaxed steady boom-bap groove with a soft kick, a gentle snare and light swung hi-hats, a round warm bass and mellow jazzy chords underneath, gentle tape warmth. Calm, warm and focused, never sleepy, never dramatic. A long, continuous piece that keeps the same easy groove all the way through, with no breakdowns and no dramatic build. It continues in this same way for many minutes. About four minutes, gentle natural ending. No vocals, no humming, no whistling. No rain, no wind, no birds, no clock ticking, no field recordings. No dog sounds, no barking.
